title: Consequences for Neighboring Conjectures
statement: The Dixmier conjecture is false for the complex Weyl algebra A_n for every n at least 3.

members.title: Failure of the all-dimensional Vanishing Conjecture
members.statement: Zhao's all-dimensional Vanishing Conjecture is false in some finite dimension.

members.title: Failure of the all-dimensional Image Conjecture
members.statement: The all-dimensional Image Conjecture is false in some finite dimension.

members.title: Failure of the Dixmier conjecture in dimensions at least three
members.statement: The Dixmier conjecture is false for the complex Weyl algebra A_n for every n at least 3.

members.title: Failure of the Jacobian conjecture in dimensions at least three
members.statement: The Jacobian conjecture is false in every dimension n at least 3.

members.title: Small counterexamples to the Gaussian Moments Conjecture
members.statement: The Gaussian Moments Conjecture is false in every dimension n at least 3: the cited preprint gives a five-term quartic witness in three real Gaussian variables and a six-term cubic witness in four variables.
